questions.stem:
Edwin instituted an action against Okoro in the High Court of Cross River State. Okoro resides in Osun State. Without obtaining leave of court, Edwin served the writ of summons on Okoro in Osun.
Advise the parties on:
i. Whether the service is valid
ii. The legal effect of non-compliance with the rules on service outside jurisdiction
iii. The options available to Okoro

Akwa Ibom State Attorney-General directed the Police to prosecute Effiong before a Magistrate's Court for the offense of murder.
Discuss whether
i. The Magistrate's Court has jurisdiction
ii. The proper court for the trial
iii. The correct procedure for commencing the prosecution

Asikpo, an unemployed graduate, wishes to institute an action against his former employer for unlawful dismissal. He approaches the Legal Aid Council for assistance but is informed that his case does not qualify for legal aid.
Discuss:
i. The scope of legal aid in civil matters
ii. The factors considered in determining eligibility for legal aid
iii. Whether the refusal is legally justifiable
iv. Alternative source of legal assistance available to Asikpo

Ndoma obtained an LL.B degree from the University of Calabar. She completed her studies but decided not to attend the Nigerian Law School because she believed her university degree alone entitled her to practice as a Lawyer. She later applied for enrolment at the Supreme Court.
Advise Ndoma on:
i. The stages of legal education in Nigeria
ii. The statutory requirements for becoming a legal practitioner
iii. The role of the Council of Legal Education and the Body of Benchers
With reference to statutory and judicial authorities, discuss the various internal conflict situations in Nigeria.
List and discuss the essential elements of jurisdiction of the High Court in Nigeria.
